notes.title: Phantom Matrix Update 0.3.24 released
notes.notes:
[h3]Game Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue that player needed to pass the prologue first level("09:00" level) every time entered the game to access the level selection scene.
(Player needs to play first stage and see cutscene at least one more time for the game to save correctly. We are really sorry for it.)
[*] Fixed the issue of not being able to enter the Prologue Boss Stage.
[/list]

notes.title: Phantom Matrix Update 0.3.16 released
notes.notes:
[h3]Game Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the operation method of the fan mechanism.
[*] Updated the visual effects of the fan.
[*] Added an air sound effect when throwing objects.
[/list]

[h3]Game Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue that player couldn't see other magnetic connections when player was within the magnetic range.
[*] Fixed the problem of the controller appearing in hand while in hand mode.
[*] Fixed some missing translations.
[*] Fixed some missing text in the hint boards.
[/list]
